newsitem.title: USA: Disney to ship 21 million copies of "Toy Story".
newsitem.headline: Disney to ship 21 million copies of "Toy Story".

text.p: Move over, Simba. Buzz Lightyear and friends are planning to take home video sales for Walt Disney Co.'s "Toy Story" to "infinity and beyond" next week when the animated blockbuster hits store shelves.

Buena Vista Home Video, the distribution arm for Disney, Wednesday said it has received more than 21 million orders for "Toy Story" videos from retailers, topping the 20 million initial orders it received for "The Lion King", Disney's most successful animated film of all time.
"Toy Story", which has grossed more than $200 million, goes on sale Oct. 29.
Disney said the launch is being supported by the largest ever promotional effort behind a single release, with help from a number of leading U.S. companies, such as Eastman Kodak and General Mills.
"Toy Story" featuring the voices of Tom Hanks and Tim Allen, is the first full length animated feature to be created entirely by computer.
